name: Personal
description: Everyday life: errands, shopping, health, home. GROUPING: one note per list or theme (e.g. 'things to buy'); lists use checkboxes and new items append to the existing list.

name: Work
description: Job stuff: meetings, tasks, people, projects. GROUPING: one note per meeting or project; follow-ups about the same meeting or project append to that note.

name: Ideas
description: Thoughts, product ideas, things to explore. GROUPING: one note per idea or theme; later thoughts on the same theme append to that note.

name: To-dos
description: Things to do: calls, errands, follow-ups. GROUPING: one checklist note per area of life (e.g. 'personal to-dos', 'work to-dos'). Each task is a checkbox - [ ] …. Keep any timing exactly as said ('next week', 'on the 12th'); never turn it into a date. Shopping lists are not to-dos; they belong in Personal.
